description_en: Queries the total count and proportions of HTTP status codes for accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData查询加速域名HTTP返回码的总数和占比数据
name: DescribeDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

You can specify up to 100 domain names at a time
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

一次最多可以传100个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the data to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The English name of the ISP. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISPs. By default, all ISPs are queried
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html获得，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The English name of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions. By default, all regions are queried
parameters.help_zh: 地域英文名。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html获得，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en:
The time interval between two consecutive records. Unit: seconds.

The value of this parameter is fixed to 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes), or 3600 (1 hour) based on the maximum time range of a single query. For more information, see the time granularity of the returned data timestamp in the usage notes
DataInterval.description_zh:
每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数固定返回60（1分钟）、300（5分钟）或3600（1小时），具体请参见使用说明中返回数据时间粒度

DomainName.description_en: The information about the accelerated domain names

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 结束时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 开始时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间
